title: Equipment rental whose notice period is written out in words
notes: Thirty calendar days is the truth, but notice-period.ts accepts only digit-led wording, so faithful wording forces notice_period_days to null. The notice span uses a typographic apostrophe.

clauses.span: After the initial rental period, this Agreement continues automatically from month to month until terminated under Section 6.
either party may terminate this Agreement by giving the other party not less than thirty (30) days’ prior written notice
Renter shall pay the rent for the remainder of the initial rental period
